outcome: Diagnostic accuracy for GDM and FGR
cohort: The participants were pregnant individuals with gestational diabetes mellitus (n=15), fetal growth restriction (n=12), and gestational age-matched normal controls (n=19 for GDM control, n=15 for FGR control).
finding: The velocity of ballistic microcirculatory flow (v_b) of the whole placenta was significantly lower in both GDM and FGR pregnancies compared to controls, demonstrating superior diagnostic performance for these conditions.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, when participants underwent FC and NC-encoded IVIM scans.
gest_age: Participants were gestational age-matched, but specific gestational ages are not provided.
